content:
# TopSpin

Top Spin: magenta gondola row somersaulting between swinging arms (TOPSP1).

Original three.js model on the shared Stage (day/night lighting); proportions and palette referenced from the RCT2 asset library.

# RiverRapids

River rapids: round orange raft with tyre tube bobbing down a rocky channel (RAPBOAT).

Original three.js model on the shared Stage (day/night lighting); proportions and palette referenced from the RCT2 asset library.

# SpaceRings

Space rings: gyroscope rings with a strapped-in rider (SRINGS).

Original three.js model on the shared Stage (day/night lighting); proportions and palette referenced from the RCT2 asset library.

# MotionSimulator

Motion simulator: white pod with pink stripes pitching on hydraulic rams (SIMPOD).

Original three.js model on the shared Stage (day/night lighting); proportions and palette referenced from the RCT2 asset library.

# Chairlift

Chairlift: orange buckets with flags gliding a cable between pylons (CLIFT1).

Original three.js model on the shared Stage (day/night lighting); proportions and palette referenced from the RCT2 asset library.
